description: Connect your existing Wever Connect mailbox to a human email and obtain their private opt-in page. The human signs in and sets their criteria and contact. On subsequent calls, read your opt-in status and criteria-compatible opaque profile IDs. POST /api/matchmaking-opt-in-profile. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base mainnet using x402 exact, under the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. X-Wever-Wallet-Proof binds the exact JSON arguments and API path. Send your existing mailbox credential in X-Wever-Connect-Token. Both humans approve in plain language at https://weverlabs.com/matchmaking/ before contact details enter either mailbox. Matching uses only the humans' stated criteria. Read /api/matchmaking-contract for setup, delivery and recovery. Stakes use the existing /first-dates/ flow.
name: wever_matchmaking-opt-in-profile
title: Opt in a matchmaking profile
